purpose: Evaluate adopted document postprocessing and source-linked retrieval on actual OCR from licensed frozen scans; never claim fresh TeleOCR or general engine qualification.

corpus.image_pin_policy: Require exact frozen SHA256; up to4 URL/fallback rounds; retain every mismatch; never repin or substitute pages.

ocr_provider.route: Frozen image -> one fresh sequential Tesseract PDF/text/TSV pass -> native Marker text provider

scoring.text: Report raw whitespace-normalized CER/WER and existing canonical scorer CER/CER-nospace/WER/word-recall/length ratio; never use gold to construct OCR input.
scoring.layout: Export native leaf blocks in pixel coordinates of the original image; retain table HTML, order and types; existing unchanged scorer.
scoring.partial_gold: Report CORD full-page CER/WER as descriptive only; annotated-field word recall and table-cell F1 govern its absolute quality.
scoring.qualification: Report coverage, structural validity, nonregression and absolute quality separately. Complete panel qualification requires all57 input pins and every applicable threshold; any miss stays visible. Neutral/no-change arms do not demonstrate quality improvement.

retrieval.backend: actual CrispEmbed CPU F32, sequential n_threads=1; normalized mean-pooled384d vectors
retrieval.documents: All17 English gold pages; off=existing native leaf text blocks; on=assembled_chunks, with identical deterministic windowing. Do not silently remove failed pages.
retrieval.truncation: No truncation: cover all chunk text with bounded windows; at most242 WordPiece tokens including specials.
retrieval.ranking: Cosine dot product; page score=max over its windows; descending score then page ID for ties.
retrieval.query_origin: Independently authored paraphrases of frozen gold before candidate output; one predeclared query for every English page.

queries.text: Why is it difficult to describe a constitution while it is still changing?
How does spring drought affect the red rings of tree growth?
Which census schedule asks about households, parents' birthplaces, literacy, and employment?
What ornamental designs and library interiors appear on historical bookplates?
What devices help train crews know their location where positive train control is not installed?
When must a ship's master submit an additional cargo report about spirits, wines and teas?
How does the cabinet chapter describe the difference between British constitutional theory and actual practice?
Which encyclopaedia contributor writes on sponges and teaches zoology at King's College?
Which contents list describes the Philadelphia Congress, rights, and Chatham's proposals about America?
How did uncertain American territorial boundaries and rival claims to Silesia contribute to war?
Where does the library catalogue list reference books, ethics, and religion?
How can confusing observation with inference distort sociological arguments about marriage and mortality?
Where are the two pillars of Asoka near Delhi described?
What aim does Emerson assign to science when asking about the purpose of nature?
What sequence of English strata includes Bagshot sand, London clay, chalk and Portland oolite?
Where can alternating freshwater and marine formations be seen in the Isle of Wight?
Which contents page lists Cakchiquel timekeeping, family names, language and the Annals of Xahila?

retrieval.nonregression: Each query reciprocal rank, aggregate MRR and Recall@3 may not decrease; retain all full score matrices and misses.
retrieval.quality_scope: English17page corpus only; no multilingual embedding or general retrieval claim.

resources.restricted_model_acknowledgements: No restricted model needed; do not set a restricted-model acknowledgement for this lane.
resources.runtime_metrics: Record per-page wall times, child peak RSS, feature processing wall times, generated artifact sizes and retrieval encoding wall/RSS.

limits: The gold has derived and partly unreviewed layout annotations; report provenance strata and avoid claiming independent manual box qualification.
Corpus pages are independent; do not manufacture adjacency across unrelated/missing pages or claim real cross-page continuation coverage.
Tesseract quality is a new explicit provider lane, not native TeleOCR execution or original-model parity.
Retained TeleOCR OCR output replay, if added, is separately identified and never counted as fresh inference.
